component.name: ITK-SNAP
component.summary: Segment anatomical structures in 3D medical images

description.p: ITK-SNAP provides manual and semi-automatic segmentation of anatomical structures in three-dimensional medical images, with linked slice views and 3D visualization.
This community package installs the official upstream Linux build unmodified.

Medical images and segmentations can be opened and saved in Documents and Downloads. To use another dataset folder, grant it with flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/data io.github.pyushkevich.itksnap. Undo custom permissions with flatpak override --user --reset io.github.pyushkevich.itksnap.

Optional online services require flatpak override --user --share=network io.github.pyushkevich.itksnap. Undo this with flatpak override --user --unshare=network io.github.pyushkevich.itksnap. AI segmentation through an external Python server is not included in this package.
